easyPrerequisites: You control eight or fewer lands.
description:
Activate Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Budoka Gardener // Dokai, Weaver of Life.
Repeat.
